title: Finite etale descent of the existence of a lisse integral structure
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite with valuation ring $A=\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme], on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] write $A_X(V)=C(|V|,A)$ and $E_X(V)=C(|V|,E)$, with pointwise ring operations and restriction by precomposition. Here pro-etale locally free of finite rank means that there is a covering of the final object in the pro-etale site on each member of which the module is isomorphic to a finite direct sum of copies of its coefficient ring sheaf; ranks may vary between members, and rank zero is allowed. Inverse images are those of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Modules and tensor products are sheaf modules and sheaf tensor products [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Assume that the underlying topological space of $X$ is noetherian (every ascending chain of opens stabilizes). Let $p:Y\to X$ be finite etale and surjective [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category, def-weil-surjective-morphism]. Let $L$ be an $E_X$-module sheaf pro-etale locally free of finite rank. If there is an $A_Y$-module sheaf $M$ pro-etale locally free of finite rank with $E_Y\otimes_{A_Y}M\cong p^{-1}L$, then there exists an $A_X$-module sheaf $M_0$ pro-etale locally free of finite rank with $E_X\otimes_{A_X}M_0\cong L$. No descent datum on $M$ is required, and no assertion that $p^{-1}M_0$ equals the specified $M$ is made.
